# Rejected Containment candidate v4

The maintainer did not accept deterministic candidate v4 at commit `7ac6ba8`
on 2026-08-15. The chassis, crown, navigation, wheel, progress-detail, and
destination direction were retained for the successor, but the candidate
omitted live Academic Assignment entry and placed Needs Attention too low in
the landscape right-side instrument stack.

Every `candidate-v4-*` file in this directory is historical rejection evidence
only. `candidate-v4-runtime-proof-manifest.json` preserves the original hashes.
None of these images is an acceptance baseline or a current review target.
